title: Welcome to the official Gilgame studio website
excerpt: Small steps, sparkling adventures. The official website of independent game developer Gilgame studio is now open. This is where we’ll share our creative journey and studio news.

content.text: Welcome to our official website. Gilgame studio is an independent game studio turning little “what ifs” into games.
The joy of discovery, the thrill of making something work, and worlds you want to return to. These are the experiences we cherish as we create games that bring a smile.
We’ve launched this website as a home for sharing what we’re making.
A new step forward, with Gilgame
Here to welcome you is Gilgame, our sky-blue companion with a golden shell and a blue crystal on the forehead.

With white and sky-blue tones, crystal-blue accents, and touches of sparkling gold, this site reflects the little adventures ahead. Together with Gilgame, we hope to make it a welcoming place to drop by.
Games: Introductions to the games we’re making and information about each project.
Journal: Development updates, thoughts from the creative process, and studio news.
About: Get to know the studio and the things we value in making games.
We’ll be preparing game introductions little by little. This first announcement marks the beginning of our creative journal.
Thanks for joining us at the start
It’s a small beginning, but we’ll keep building our games and this website, treasuring each discovery along the way.
We’d love for you to visit again whenever we cross your mind. Thank you for being part of Gilgame and Gilgame studio’s journey.

seo_description: The official Gilgame studio website is here. Join Gilgame for game introductions, development stories, and news from our independent studio.
